cohort: Development discovery. Prior use of these dates is retained; none is called independent confirmation.
static_feed: Existing Swiss/Zurich feed_version 20231024; main dates are strictly later. Earlier dates remain source-coverage inventory only.
model: Existing rail EvolvingTripBelief, 60-second original DELAYS support, independent physical vehicle chains, existing 2023-10-01/02 fit and cancel_persistence=0.9. No refitting to discovery outcomes.
numeric_messages: Latest receipt per endpoint replaces prior forecast. Existing Gaussian emission with sd=max(30,60*training route std), own observed endpoint overrides its forecast. This noise model is declared, not calibrated to these forecast errors.
message_clock: max(archive capture, feed header, individual TripUpdate timestamp); 10-minute archived capture sampling, 07:00 through 09:40. Future receipts never enter current choices.
future_messages: No generative law for future message revisions is assumed. Conditional scores hold the currently received forecast snapshot; actual replay updates at subsequent decision times. Exact references can only cover that declared conditional problem.
public_observations: Own reached departures/arrivals and local departures observed only during each platform visit; past-visit absence windows stop at departure. All controls share history and current messages.
selection: Enumerate one earliest in-window departure per physical trip and all qualifying goals using schedule-only V32 dual-hub/downstream-only topology. Save the full candidate catalogue before eligibility assessment. Keep roots with complete consistent endpoint labels for the entire retained menu and a relevant future-tail numeric message received by the first irreversible arrival; selection uses label coverage and message timing, never travel loss, forecast value or algorithm advantage. Round-robin direct/shared/two-transfer layers in fixed candidate order, one root per first vehicle and route/OD, at most twelve per day.
menu: Every retained first- and subsequent-vehicle exit and variant is common and fixed; no route deleted after outcomes. Original GTFS max-stated station MCT with existing fallback120.
quality: Truncated actual journey loss, public action differences and unresolved/support failures, paired by frozen root. Information gain and control gain are reported separately.
conditional_reference: At most four earliest distinct public-action divergences between the cheap frontier and deeper control. Current-snapshot original-law or independently sampled conditional continuation checks retain both signs; no actual future enters reference decisions.
admission: Reconstruction requires an interpretable natural residual beyond all common-information cheap controls. A forecast benefit shared by cheap methods, a repaired missing action, or hindsight alone does not admit a new algorithm.
timing: Charge model/posterior, message application, all tail compilation and decisions; report process CPU and wall separately. Logical-clock action quality is a discovery probe; computational feasibility must be evaluated before production claims.
service_messages: Current CANCELED/DELETED trip or SKIPPED endpoint notices mask unobserved future opportunities in planning until a later SCHEDULED/FORECAST revision. An already observed operating/locally boardable event overrides the prior notice. Announcements never rewrite physical actual endpoints. This is a common operational planning rule, not calibrated physical cancellation evidence.
